en.name: Kalashnikov AM-17 Gen.3 5.45x39 assault rifle
en.description: The Kalashnikov Concern AM-17 (Russian: Aвтомат Малогабаритный, romanized: Avtomat Malogabaritnyj, lit. 'Small-sized Automatic Rifle', GRAU index: 6P74) is a compact assault rifle chambered in 5.45×39mm intermediate cartridge, developed and manufactured by Kalashnikov Concern as a replacement to the AKS-74U. The AM-17 was first unveiled in the Russian Army Expo 2017 alongside the integrally suppressed AMB-17. Its development began in the late 2010s, and was based on the Yevgeny Dragunov MA compact assault rifle. In November 2024, the AM-17 has completed the acceptance trials. Serial production of the carbine is expected to begin in 2025. On September 1, 2025, Kalashnikov Concern reported that the first experimental batch of the AM-17 had been manufactured. Newer version developed for the conflict in tarkov, allows the use of m4 style pistolgrips.
